title: UserPrincipal
description: A user Principal registered in the AgentTrust federation. Users are identified by their ed25519 Principal and may have an optional username for display.

principal_id.description: Unique identifier for the user Principal (ed25519 key).

username.description: Optional human-readable username. Not unique, not trusted.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this user was registered.

last_active.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent user activity (login, reputation update).

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
